question: How many trucks did the loading dock camera pick up yesterday?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND t.class_name = 'truck' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: How many dogs were spotted in the parking lot this week?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name = 'dog' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: Count the elevator zone entries in the lobby yesterday.
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'elevators' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: Events, not distinct people: a second visit counts again.

question: How many objects of any kind did the parking lot camera track in the last 30 minutes?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.last_seen >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND t.first_seen < %(now)s

question: How many vehicles (cars, trucks and motorcycles) were in the parking lot yesterday?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name IN ('car', 'truck', 'motorcycle') AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: How many zone exits were recorded at each checkout register this morning?
sql: SELECT z.name AS zone, count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND e.event_type = 'zone_exit' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY z.name

question: How many umbrellas showed up on the lobby camera this week?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND t.class_name = 'umbrella' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: How many detections did the lobby camera produce in the last hour?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND d.ts >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '1 hours' AND d.ts < %(now)s

question: Number of trucks at the loading dock yesterday?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND t.class_name = 'truck' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: What was the average confidence of person detections at the checkout yesterday?
sql: SELECT avg(d.confidence) AS value FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND d.class_name = 'person' AND d.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND d.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: On average, for how many frames is a car tracked in the parking lot?
sql: SELECT avg(t.n_frames) AS value FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name = 'car'

question: Average detection confidence for each object class in the lobby last week?
sql: SELECT d.class_name, avg(d.confidence) AS value FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND d.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND d.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY d.class_name

question: For each camera, what was the mean confidence of truck detections over the last 3 days?
sql: SELECT c.name AS camera, avg(d.confidence) AS value FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE d.class_name = 'truck' AND d.ts >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '3 days' AND d.ts < %(now)s GROUP BY c.name

question: List the five most recent zone events in the lobby.
sql: SELECT e.event_id, e.ts FROM events e JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' ORDER BY e.ts DESC, e.event_id DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the last 3 trucks that arrived at the loading dock.
sql: SELECT t.track_id, t.first_seen FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND t.class_name = 'truck' ORDER BY t.first_seen DESC, t.track_id DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which people entered the elevators zone between 9:00 and 9:15 this morning?
sql: SELECT t.track_id FROM tracks t WHERE t.class_name = 'person' AND t.track_id IN (SELECT e.track_id FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'elevators' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 09:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 09:15') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)

question: Show the 4 latest detections of a suitcase in the lobby.
sql: SELECT d.frame_id, d.ts FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND d.class_name = 'suitcase' ORDER BY d.ts DESC LIMIT 4

question: How many times did someone go in through the front door between 8am and 10am on 27 March?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'front_door' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-27 08:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-27 10:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: How many people were in the lobby last night?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: How many cars did the parking lot see last week, Monday to Sunday?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name = 'car' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: Last week spans London's change to summer time (29 March).

question: Break down this morning's people count by camera.
sql: SELECT c.name AS camera, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY c.name
notes: Morning is 06:00-12:00 local per camera: London and New York differ by 5 hours.

question: How many zone entries were there across all zones between 23:00 on 28 March and 03:00 on 29 March?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-28 23:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-29 03:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: London skips 01:00-02:00 that night: the window is 3 real hours there.

question: How many different people used the elevators this week?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.track_id) AS n FROM events e JOIN tracks t ON t.track_id = e.track_id JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'elevators' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: For each checkout zone, how many different people entered it yesterday?
sql: SELECT z.name AS zone, count(DISTINCT e.track_id) AS n FROM events e JOIN tracks t ON t.track_id = e.track_id JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY z.name

question: How many parking lot frames from today contain a truck detected with a confidence of at least 0.8?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.frame_id IN (SELECT d.frame_id FROM detections d WHERE d.class_name = 'truck' AND d.confidence >= 0.8)

question: Break down yesterday's front door events by type.
sql: SELECT e.event_type, count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'front_door' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY e.event_type

question: Show the number of people in the lobby per hour this morning.
sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket
notes: Tracks fall in the hour of first_seen (local).

question: Daily truck counts at the loading dock over the last 7 days.
sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND t.class_name = 'truck' AND t.last_seen >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '7 days' AND t.first_seen < %(now)s GROUP BY date_trunc('day', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket
notes: 25 March has no row: the camera was offline.

question: How many zone entries did the front door get per day this week?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', e.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'front_door' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY date_trunc('day', e.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket

question: How many cars has the parking lot seen each week?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name = 'car' GROUP BY date_trunc('week', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket
notes: No time range: every week in the data; weeks start on Monday.

question: Hourly people counts at the entrance and the checkout today, per camera.
sql: SELECT c.name AS camera, date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name IN ('entrance', 'checkout') AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY c.name, date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket, camera

question: Which hour yesterday had the most people at the entrance?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'entrance' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY n DESC, bucket LIMIT 1

question: How many frames per hour did the loading dock camera store on 25 and 26 March?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', f.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND f.ts >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-25 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-27 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', f.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY bucket
notes: No frames on the 25th (outage): 24 hourly rows, all on the 26th.

question: Top 3 classes by number of detections in the lobby over the last 3 days.
sql: SELECT d.class_name, count(*) AS n FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND d.ts >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '3 days' AND d.ts < %(now)s GROUP BY d.class_name ORDER BY n DESC, d.class_name LIMIT 3

question: Name the 2 zones with the most loitering events overall.
sql: SELECT z.name AS zone, count(*) AS n FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id WHERE e.event_type = 'loiter' GROUP BY z.name ORDER BY n DESC, z.name LIMIT 2

question: What are the 3 busiest cameras by number of detections this afternoon?
sql: SELECT c.name AS camera, count(*) AS n FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE d.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND d.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '18 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC, c.name LIMIT 3
notes: The lobby's afternoon (New York) has not started yet.

question: What was the longest visit to register 2 yesterday?
sql: SELECT max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM v.exited - v.entered)) AS value FROM (SELECT e.track_id, e.zone_id, min(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_enter') AS entered, max(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_exit') AS exited FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'register_2' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY e.track_id, e.zone_id) v WHERE v.exited > v.entered

question: How long did cars stay in the parking lot on average today?
sql: SELECT avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.last_seen - t.first_seen)) AS value FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.class_name = 'car' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: Average dwell time per checkout register this week.
sql: SELECT z.name AS zone, avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM v.exited - v.entered)) AS value FROM (SELECT e.track_id, e.zone_id, min(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_enter') AS entered, max(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_exit') AS exited FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY e.track_id, e.zone_id) v JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = v.zone_id WHERE v.exited > v.entered GROUP BY z.name

question: What's the shortest time anyone spent in the front door zone yesterday?
sql: SELECT min(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM v.exited - v.entered)) AS value FROM (SELECT e.track_id, e.zone_id, min(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_enter') AS entered, max(e.ts) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'zone_exit') AS exited FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'front_door' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY e.track_id, e.zone_id) v JOIN tracks t ON t.track_id = v.track_id WHERE t.class_name = 'person' AND v.exited > v.entered

question: Show me the 5 most recent frames from the loading dock with a truck.
sql: SELECT f.frame_id FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'loading_dock' AND f.frame_id IN (SELECT d.frame_id FROM detections d WHERE d.class_name = 'truck') ORDER BY f.ts DESC, f.frame_id DESC LIMIT 5

question: Pull up the latest frame from the entrance that shows a dog.

question: Show frames from the checkout with a cell phone between 11am and noon today.

question: Which entrance frames from the last 15 minutes contain a person?
sql: SELECT f.frame_id FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'entrance' AND f.ts >= %(now)s - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND f.ts < %(now)s AND f.frame_id IN (SELECT d.frame_id FROM detections d WHERE d.class_name = 'person')
notes: Includes frames whose only person is an untracked low-confidence detection.

question: What was the average brightness of parking lot frames last night?
sql: SELECT avg(f.brightness) AS value FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: Brightness is not a plan measure.

question: Averaged over last week, which hour of the day had the most people in the lobby?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS hour, count(*) / 7.0 AS avg_people FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.first_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.first_seen AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) ORDER BY avg_people DESC LIMIT 1
notes: Hour of day across days: trend buckets are timestamps, not hours of the day.

question: What percentage of today's detections at the checkout had a confidence below 0.5?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.confidence < 0.5) / count(*) AS pct FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND d.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND d.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: A percentage, and an upper bound on confidence.

question: What was the average number of detections per frame in the lobby yesterday?
sql: SELECT count(d.frame_id)::double precision / count(DISTINCT f.frame_id) AS value FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id LEFT JOIN detections d ON d.frame_id = f.frame_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: What was the average number of people per day at the entrance last week?
sql: SELECT count(*) / 7.0 AS value FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'entrance' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.first_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: Find the parking lot frames from this week that contain a bicycle.
sql: SELECT f.frame_id, f.ts FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.frame_id IN (SELECT d.frame_id FROM detections d WHERE d.class_name = 'bicycle')

question: Which lobby frames this morning contain a suitcase?
sql: SELECT f.frame_id, f.ts FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '6 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.frame_id IN (SELECT d.frame_id FROM detections d WHERE d.class_name = 'suitcase')

How many people has the entrance seen today compared with yesterday by the same time?
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS today, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < %(now)s - INTERVAL '1 day') AS yesterday_so_far FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'entrance' AND t.class_name = 'person'

question: What was the average gap in seconds between consecutive entries into register 1 today?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(e.ts) - min(e.ts)) / (count(*) - 1) AS avg_gap_s FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'register_1' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: Gaps between consecutive rows (the mean gap is the span over n - 1).

question: How many tracks at the entrance today entered the front door zone more than once?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT e.track_id FROM events e JOIN zones z ON z.zone_id = e.zone_id JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = e.camera_id WHERE z.name = 'front_door' AND e.event_type = 'zone_enter' AND e.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND e.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY e.track_id HAVING count(*) > 1) s
notes: A filter on a per-track count (HAVING).

question: For each hour of the day, what was the average frame brightness at the parking lot last week?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS hour, avg(f.brightness) AS brightness FROM frames f JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = f.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND f.ts >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND f.ts < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM f.ts AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)

question: What fraction of yesterday's checkout detections had no track?
sql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN d.track_id IS NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share FROM detections d JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = d.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'checkout' AND d.ts >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND d.ts < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
notes: A share, and a filter on a missing track.

question: How many more people did the entrance see on Saturday 28 March than on Saturday 21 March?
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.last_seen >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-28 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-29 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.last_seen >= (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-21 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-22 00:00') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) AS difference FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'entrance' AND t.class_name = 'person'

question: How many seconds passed between the first and the last person seen in the lobby today?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM max(t.last_seen) - min(t.first_seen)) AS span_s FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'lobby' AND t.class_name = 'person' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('day', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone

question: What is the ratio of cars to trucks in the parking lot this week?
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.class_name = 'car')::double precision / count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.class_name = 'truck') AS ratio FROM tracks t JOIN cameras c ON c.camera_id = t.camera_id WHERE c.name = 'parking_lot' AND t.last_seen >= (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone)) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone AND t.first_seen < (date_trunc('week', %(now)s AT TIME ZONE c.timezone) + INTERVAL '7 days') AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
